name: Omarchy Help
author: modpunk
description: Offline help for Omarchy. Type to search your live keybindings, the omarchy CLI, and the manual for your installed version — results appear as you type, with no network and no model. Press Enter on a manual topic to have a local LLM explain it in plain language.
